questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: In Schedule 05 Question 1: Kepler's second law of planetary motion (law of areas) is a direct consequence of the conservation of which physical quantity?
options: Angular momentum about the central attracting body
Linear momentum along the orbital tangent
Total mechanical energy alone
Gravitational potential gradient
questions.correctAnswer: Angular momentum about the central attracting body
questions.solution: Areal velocity dA/dt = L / (2m). Since gravitational force is strictly central, torque tau = r x F = 0, so angular momentum L is conserved and areal velocity is constant.
questions.sourceLocator: NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch 08 Sections & Exercises

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: In Schedule 05 Question 36: At what height h in kilometers above the Earth's surface does acceleration due to gravity become 1/4 of its surface value g? (Take Earth radius R = 6400 km).
questions.solution: g_h = g / (1 + h/R)^2. Setting (1 + h/R) = 2 gives h = 1 * R = 6400 km.
questions.sourceLocator: NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch 08 Sections & Exercises
